title: It's not you. Bad doors are everywhere.
summary: Vox's Joe Posner, with help from 99% Invisible, explains why bad doors are everywhere. It covers Don Norman's long-running complaint about doors and the idea that good design should not need instructions.
why: HN uses it as the short, canonical explainer of Norman doors and affordances, linked in design and UX discussions.

quote.text: The Vox vodcast(?) in [1] goes a lot further into the problem, starting from a very similar door.
